
REMOVE-VIRTUAL-HOOK
Remove a specific virtual hook from a work unit

WHEN TO USE
  Use this command to remove a specific virtual hook from a work unit. Removes the hook configuration from spec/work-units.json and cleans up any generated script files in spec/hooks/.virtual/. Useful for removing broken hooks, hooks that are no longer needed, or correcting mistakes.

PREREQUISITES
  • Work unit must exist
  • Work unit must have virtual hooks configured
  • Hook name must match exactly (case-sensitive)

USAGE
  fspec remove-virtual-hook <workUnitId> <hookName>

ARGUMENTS
  <workUnitId> (required)
    Work unit ID to remove hook from (e.g., AUTH-001)
  <hookName> (required)
    Name of the hook to remove (e.g., eslint, prettier, typecheck)

OPTIONS
  No options available

COMMON PATTERNS
  • Remove Broken Hook
    Example: fspec remove-virtual-hook AUTH-001 eslin
fspec add-virtual-hook AUTH-001 post-implementing "eslint src/" --blocking
    Remove hook with typo in command name, then add corrected version.

  • Replace Hook Configuration
    Example: fspec remove-virtual-hook AUTH-001 eslint
fspec add-virtual-hook AUTH-001 post-implementing "eslint src/" --git-context --blocking
    Remove existing hook and add new one with different configuration (e.g., add git context).

  • Remove After Workflow Transition
    Example: fspec update-work-unit-status AUTH-001 done
# Hook failed, no longer needed:
fspec remove-virtual-hook AUTH-001 experimental-check
    Remove experimental or one-time hooks after work unit completion.


TYPICAL WORKFLOW
  fspec list-virtual-hooks → Identify hook to remove → fspec remove-virtual-hook → Verify removal

EXAMPLES
  1. Remove the eslint hook from AUTH-001
  $ fspec remove-virtual-hook AUTH-001 eslint
  ✓ Removed virtual hook 'eslint' from AUTH-001
  Remaining virtual hooks: 1

  2. Remove type check hook from BUG-042
  $ fspec remove-virtual-hook BUG-042 typecheck
  ✓ Removed virtual hook 'typecheck' from BUG-042
  Remaining virtual hooks: 0

COMMON ERRORS
  ✗ Work unit 'AUTH-001' does not exist
    Fix: Check work unit ID spelling. List all work units: fspec list-work-units

  ✗ No virtual hooks configured for AUTH-001
    Fix: Work unit has no hooks to remove. List hooks: fspec list-virtual-hooks AUTH-001

  ✗ Virtual hook 'eslin' not found in AUTH-001
    Fix: Check hook name spelling. List hooks: fspec list-virtual-hooks AUTH-001 (correct name might be "eslint")

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-virtual-hook
  fspec list-virtual-hooks
  fspec clear-virtual-hooks

NOTES
  • Hook name is auto-generated from command (e.g., "<quality-check-commands>" → based on actual tool)
  • To find hook names, use: fspec list-virtual-hooks <workUnitId>
  • Automatically cleans up script files in spec/hooks/.virtual/
  • If multiple hooks have same name at different events, only first is removed
  • To remove ALL hooks, use: fspec clear-virtual-hooks
  • Operation is permanent - hook configuration cannot be recovered
